title: cCondFork5
summary: 结构子 cCondFork5 的协议摘要，family 为 SelSplit。

semantic_contract.event_behavior: There is exactly one upstream event driver (i_drive role) and one upstream release (o_free role).
semantic_contract.data_behavior: This family primarily communicates through event handshakes.
semantic_contract.completion_behavior: Selected channel's i_free[k] triggers upstream o_free

release_rule.details: Selected channel's i_free[k] triggers upstream o_free

backpressure_behavior.blocking_condition: Selected channel's i_free[k] triggers upstream o_free

family_invariants: There is exactly one upstream event driver (i_drive role) and one upstream release (o_free role).
There are NUM_PORTS downstream channels; each channel has a drive-out o_drive[k] and a paired free-in i_free[k].
Selection condition determines which channel receives the event drive (o_drive[k]).
Upstream release o_free is derived from the paired i_free of the selected channel by default (unless explicitly overridden by implementation).
